name: Summer Fun Program
description_short: A summer day program run by Medford Community Schools for kids going into Grades 1–8. It is held at the Missituk School and includes sports, games, arts and crafts, movies and swimming. Staff are Medford Public Schools teachers plus college and high school students.
special_needs_notes: For IEPs, 504 plans or behavior plans, contact Director Anthony Petrelis (apetrelis@medford.k12.ma.us) to arrange accommodations. Children not enrolled in Medford Public Schools must send a recent physical exam and immunization records to District Health Services (jsilva@medford.k12.ma.us) at least 3 business days before their first day.
swim_waterfront_notes: There is an outdoor swimming pool on site. Campers bring a bathing suit, a towel and sandals (for the pool only). Lifeguard and swim-test details are not stated.
